vendors.enrichHowTo: Get the data model with GET /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec, edit descriptions in the JSON or YAML, then send it with PUT /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec. Each update needs schemaVersion. Descriptions can also be inherited from the warehouse or imported from dbt.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Edit descriptions in spec.json (keep schemaVersion), then replace the data model pages
curl -X PUT "$SIGMA_API_URL/v2/dataModels/$DATA_MODEL_ID/spec" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @spec.json
# add your API token header as shown in the Sigma API docs

notes.text: Most vendor doc hosts were blocked, WebFetch failed with DNS errors, and the search budget ran out. Facts come from search result summaries and a few GitHub raw pages. Caps scored 0 with the note 'Not verified' mean unknown, not absent.
